content.short: NMKR makes it easy to create, mint, and sell NFTs and native tokens across multiple blockchains at once.
content.description: NMKR is a premier infrastructure provider for the Cardano ecosystem, simplifying the process of creating, minting, and selling NFTs and native tokens. Trusted by thousands of creators and businesses, the platform offers a suite of tools for multi-chain distribution, including support for blockchains like Bitcoin, Solana, and Midnight. NMKR's user-friendly interface allows for rapid deployment of tokenization projects without requiring deep technical knowledge. By bridging the gap between brands and blockchain, NMKR empowers a global community to reach new audiences and monetize digital assets.
content.meta: NMKR is a leading Cardano infrastructure platform for multi-chain NFT minting and tokenization services. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
